title: ADAPT: Adaptive Decision and Abstention with Pool-Size-Aware Thresholds for Service Routing
abstract: arXiv:2611.25754v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-based classifiers efficiently route queries to specialised services, but they typically select a candidate even when no suitable service exists. We introduce Adaptive Decision and Abstention with Pool-Size-Aware Thresholds for Service Routing (ADAPT), a lightweight routing architecture with an explicit fallback option that enables queries to abstain from specialist selection. ADAPT uses the separation between the highest relevance score and the candidate score distribution as routing confidence. Experiments across retrieval models and increasing numbers of services reveal a consistent empirical behaviour: the confidence distribution changes systematically with candidate-pool size K, making fixed abstention thresholds increasingly miscalibrated. translated_title: ADAPT：面向服务路由的池大小感知阈值自适应决策与弃权方法
translated_abstract: 基于检索的分类器能够高效地将查询路由到专门的服务，但即使不存在合适的服务，它们通常仍会选择一个候选服务。我们提出了面向服务路由的池大小感知阈值自适应决策与弃权方法（ADAPT），这是一种轻量级的路由架构，具有显式的回退选项，使查询能够放弃选择专门服务。ADAPT 使用最高相关分数与候选分数分布之间的差距作为路由置信度。跨多种检索模型和不断增加的服务数量的实验揭示了一致的实证现象：置信度分布会随候选池大小 K 系统性地变化，导致固定的弃权阈值变得越来越校准失准。ADAPT 通过一个 K 感知阈值来解决这一问题，该阈值能够随服务的添加而自适应调整，无需重新训练分类器。在两个专门领域数据集上的评估表明，这种简单的机制能够有效改善路由决策的可靠性。
tldr: ADAPT 是一种轻量级服务路由架构，通过引入显式弃权回退机制和随候选池大小 K 自适应调整的阈值，解决了固定弃权阈值在服务数量增加时校准失准的问题，且无需重新训练分类器。
en_tdlr: ADAPT is a lightweight service routing architecture that introduces an explicit abstention fallback and a K-aware threshold that adapts as services are added, addressing the miscalibration of fixed abstention thresholds without classifier retraining.
